title: Accu-Check Insight Bluetooth Pairing "Connection failed" on P7 Android 14 QPR2 update
symptom: After an Android 14 QPR2 update on Pixel 7, the phone cannot reach the Accu-Chek Insight pump, and Bluetooth pairing fails with 'Connection failed' when the phone lists the pump. It was working before without issues.
cause: The issue was caused by a recent Android QPR2 update that broke the Bluetooth connection between Pixel 7 and the Insight pump. Google messed up with the bluetooth firmware/security patch tagging, and GrapheneOS implemented it from AOSP, which broke things.
fix: The changes were reverted by GrapheneOS developers, and after that all was good. The issue was resolved by reverting the problematic Bluetooth changes.
evidence_quote: apparently Google messed up with the bluetooth firmware/security patch tagging, the devs at GrapheneOS implemented it quickly from AOSP and it broke things. Since then they reverted the changes, so all good now.
